query.question: Client assets per advisor across the five -- and is that comparison even valid?

parts.text: Total client assets (or total client assets under administration/advisory) reported by each of the five firms in its wealth or advisor channel.
parts.keyword_query: total client assets under administration advisory assets fee-based assets wealth management segment client assets billion period end

parts.text: Number of financial advisors reported by each firm, including how the count is broken out by channel.
parts.keyword_query: number of financial advisors headcount total advisors employee advisors independent contractor advisors affiliated advisors wealth advisors Advisor Services

parts.text: Disclosed per-advisor productivity figures such as client assets per financial advisor or revenue per advisor for each firm.
parts.keyword_query: client assets per financial advisor average assets per advisor revenue per financial advisor advisor productivity annualized production per advisor

parts.text: Differences in how each firm defines client assets and advisors that affect whether per-advisor comparison is valid (employee vs independent, definitions, inclusions, workplace or self-directed assets).
parts.keyword_query: definition of client assets includes brokerage advisory retirement workplace self-directed stock plan assets definition financial advisor employee independent contractor not comparable methodology
